The null_resource register_aks_msi_preview_feature runs a local-exec script that registers the Microsoft.ContainerService "AAD-V2" feature and polls until the provider reports it as Registered (the source notes this can take around 30 minutes). The AKS cluster is created with managed Azure AD RBAC (role_based_access_control.azure_active_directory.managed = true), which requires that feature/preview registration to be complete before the cluster can be provisioned. However, azurerm_kubernetes_cluster.aks references none of the null_resource's outputs (it has none) and no attribute reference or depends_on orders the cluster after the registration resource, so Terraform may create the cluster before (or concurrently with) feature registration and fail. Add an explicit depends_on from the cluster to the null_resource.

azurerm_virtual_hub_connection.vhub_connection declares depends_on = [module.networking, module.virtual_wans]. The dependency on module.virtual_wans is redundant: the resource already references module.virtual_wans[...].virtual_hubs[...].id via the virtual_hub_id attribute (captured as implicit_deps through module.virtual_wans:output.virtual_hubs), so Terraform already orders this resource after the virtual WAN/hubs. The module.networking entry is NOT redundant (remote_virtual_network_id is resolved through local.combined_objects_networking) and should be kept.

The external data source data.external.ase_ilb_ip declares depends_on = [azurerm_template_deployment.ase], but it already depends on that resource implicitly: its `program` string interpolates lookup(azurerm_template_deployment.ase.outputs, "id"), which is captured in implicit_deps. The explicit depends_on duplicates the implicit dependency.

azurerm_private_dns_a_record.a_records declares depends_on = [azurerm_template_deployment.ase], but that ordering is already established transitively: the record consumes data.external.ase_ilb_ip (for the ILB IP in `records`), and that data source itself depends on azurerm_template_deployment.ase (both implicitly via the outputs lookup and via its own explicit depends_on). The explicit depends_on on the ASE template duplicates the transitive dependency.

null_resource.grant_admin_consent declares depends_on = [azuread_service_principal.app], but it already depends on that resource implicitly: its local-exec provisioner environment interpolates azuread_service_principal.app.id (principalId) and the resource is also listed in implicit_deps. The explicit depends_on duplicates the implicit dependency.

azurerm_site_recovery_replication_policy.policy declares depends_on = [azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault], but it already depends on the vault implicitly through the recovery_vault_name = azurerm_recovery_services_vault.asr_rg_vault.name attribute reference (captured in implicit_deps). The explicit depends_on is redundant.

azurerm_express_route_gateway.er_gateway declares depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub], but it already depends on the hub implicitly via virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id (captured in implicit_deps). The explicit depends_on is redundant.

azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway declares depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub, azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration], but both are already implicit dependencies: virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id and vpn_server_configuration_id = azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration[0].id (both captured in implicit_deps). This explicit depends_on entry duplicates the hub dependency.

azurerm_point_to_site_vpn_gateway.p2s_gateway declares depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub, azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration], but the configuration is already an implicit dependency via vpn_server_configuration_id = azurerm_vpn_server_configuration.p2s_configuration[0].id (captured in implicit_deps). This explicit depends_on entry duplicates that dependency.

azurerm_vpn_gateway.s2s_gateway declares depends_on = [azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub], but it already depends on the hub implicitly via virtual_hub_id = azurerm_virtual_hub.vwan_hub.id (captured in implicit_deps). The explicit depends_on is redundant.
